changes.source_framing: Add optional SDK query for selected local source 0 audio / 2 video / 3 screen. Existing audio-only ABI preserved. Video/screen use their own prepared child and do not inherit audio replication. Unknown sources return null; no RPC or network packet is generated.
changes.video_controller: Optional live native setter applies below-RTP overhead independently to video allocator and pacer, retains streams and path identity, requires split feedback, bounds hint 0..1024 and cancels unscheduled work at 20ms. Real path handover retains both independent hints.
changes.frame_packet_accounting: Enable the pinned WebRTC video frame-rate overhead trial; small frames cannot be modeled only as full-MTU packets.
changes.host: Refresh video or screen framing before start, after host route handover and on each stats tick. Acknowledged hints persist through unknown metadata or busy worker. Packet-size deltas use payload counters plus the negotiated 20-byte RTP header. Older SDK/native combinations remain optional/unknown.
changes.sizing: Protect actual positive VP8 allocation <=30kbit/s even when the selected profile is higher. A suspended encoder retains last positive budget. Resolution cap releases at >=60kbit/s effective allocation, including recovery without a host profile change. Complete encoded reference frames are forwarded unchanged.
changes.fixture_fidelity: Both standalone bridges now pass sourceBudgetPressured only after local source feedback was queued, matching the application. The 1:1 bridge also uses the production peer recovery de-duplication and separate local/peer witnesses. Stimulus, blind FIFO, clocks, full-file sizes and <200ms gates were not relaxed.
